local P, R, T, U = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("TextChatService"), game:GetService("UserInputService")
local L = P.LocalPlayer
local active, isLimited, St = false, false, nil

-- Main ScreenGui Container
local G = Instance.new("ScreenGui", L:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")) 
G.Name, G.ResetOnSpawn = "TsM_Spam", false

-- Massive Top-Screen Stylized Cooldown Banner (Initially Hidden)
local CdAlert = Instance.new("TextLabel", G)
CdAlert.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 90)
CdAlert.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10)
CdAlert.BackgroundTransparency = 1
CdAlert.Text = ""
CdAlert.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
CdAlert.TextSize = 45
CdAlert.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
CdAlert.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
CdAlert.Visible = false

-- 7-Second Roblox Error & Rate-Limit Handler with Screen Alert
local function triggerErrorCooldown()
    if isLimited then return end
    isLimited = true
    CdAlert.Visible = true
    
    task.spawn(function()
        for i = 7, 1, -1 do
            if CdAlert and CdAlert.Parent then
                CdAlert.Text = "ROBLOX RATE LIMIT! PAUSED: " .. tostring(i) .. "s"
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
        isLimited = false
        CdAlert.Visible = false
    end)
end

local function send(m)
    if isLimited then return end
    task.spawn(function()
        if T.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local ch = T:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
            local c = ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral") or ch:FindFirstChild("RBXSystem"))
            if c then 
                local ok, err = pcall(function() c:SendAsync(m) end)
                if not ok or (err and (err:lower():find("wait") or err:lower():find("rate") or err:lower():find("error"))) then
                    triggerErrorCooldown()
                end
            elseif T:FindFirstChild("ChatInputBarConfiguration") and T.ActiveTextBox then
                T.ActiveTextBox.Text = m 
                game:GetService("VirtualUser"):TypeKey(13)
            end
        else
            local s = R:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") and R.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if s then s:FireServer(m, "All") end
        end
    end)
end

-- Listen for chat system warning messages to automatically trigger the 7-second cooldown
if T and T.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
    T.MessageReceived:Connect(function(r)
        local msg = (r.Text or ""):lower()
        if msg:find("must wait") or msg:find("sending another message") or msg:find("error") then
            triggerErrorCooldown()
        end
    end)
end

local function filter(t) return t end
pcall(function() L.Idled:Connect(function() game:GetService("VirtualUser"):CaptureController() game:GetService("VirtualUser"):ClickButton2(Vector2.new()) end) end)
send("@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@ TsM SPAMMER LOADED🚨🚨")

I.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() M.Visible = not M.Visible end)

local function makeDraggable(obj)
    local drag, startIn, startPos
    obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then drag, startIn, startPos = true, i.Position, obj.Position end end)
    U.InputChanged:Connect(function(i) if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then local d = i.Position - startIn 
        obj.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
    end end)
    obj.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then drag = false end end)
end
makeDraggable(I) makeDraggable(M)

In:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() 
    if not active then

end)

for idx, k in ipairs(keysOrder) do
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", M) b.Size, b.Position, b.BackgroundColor3, b.Text, b.Font = UDim2.new(0,52,0,32), UDim2.new(0, 15 + (idx-1)*58, 0, 88), Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0), k, Enum.Font.FredokaOne
    Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)
    table.insert(activeButtons, b) 
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
        curT = k 
        In.Text = tgts[k]

end

task.spawn(function()
    local colors, n = {Color3.fromRGB(168,85,247), Color3.fromRGB(60,130,255), Color3.fromRGB(0,255,255), Color3.fromRGB(150,150,150), Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)}, 1
    while G.Parent do
        local c = colors[n]
        I.TextColor3, Tl.TextColor3, Bio.TextColor3, In.TextColor3, Pr.TextColor3, Dl.TextColor3, TipLbl.TextColor3, CdAlert.TextColor3 = c, c, c, c, c, c, c, c
        for i = 1, #activeButtons do activeButtons[i].TextColor3 = c end
        n = (n % #colors) + 1 task.wait(0.8)
    end
end)

St = Instance.new("TextButton", M) St.Size, St.Position, St.BackgroundColor3, St.TextColor3, St.Text, St.Font, St.TextSize = UDim2.new(0,230,0,38), UDim2.new(0,15,0,234), Color3.fromRGB(34,197,94), Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), "START SPAM", Enum.Font.FredokaOne, 16

St.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    active = not active
    if active then
        St.Text = "STOP SPAM"
        St.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
        task.spawn(function()
            local targetIndex = 1
            while active do
                local currentKey = keysOrder[targetIndex]
                local currentTargetName = tgts[currentKey] or ""
                
                In.Text = currentTargetName
                curT = currentKey
                
                local rawPrefix = Pr.Text or "@@@"
                local delayVal = tonumber(Dl.Text) or 1.0
                local randomLine = lines[math.random(1, #lines)]
                
                local tailPart = " " .. currentTargetName .. " " .. randomLine
                local targetPrefixLength = 36
                local filledPrefix = ""
                
                if #rawPrefix > 0 then
                    local unitLen = #rawPrefix + 1
                    local count = math.floor(targetPrefixLength / unitLen)
                    if count < 1 then count = 1 end
                    filledPrefix = string.rep(rawPrefix .. " ", count)
                else
                    filledPrefix = rawPrefix .. " "
                end
                
                local rawMessage = filledPrefix .. tailPart
                if #rawMessage > 195 then
                    rawMessage = rawMessage:sub(1, 195)
                end
                
                local finalMessage = filter(rawMessage)
                send(finalMessage)
                
                targetIndex = targetIndex + 1

                task.wait(delayVal)
            end

    else

end)
